articles.title: Only two consumption funds gave over 10% SIP returns in 3 years, while one scheme posted less than 1%: Here's why
articles.summary: Consumption funds have delivered widely different returns over the past three years, despite focusing on the same broad theme. Find out what drove this divergence, the role of stock selection, key sectors, and the risks investors should consider.

articles.title: Bitcoin and Dogecoin emerge as India's favourite crypto duo: New study reveals how age shapes investing preference
articles.summary: Bitcoin and Dogecoin have emerged as the most popular crypto pairing among Indian investors across age groups, according to a report. While younger investors are driving new participation, older investors display stronger buying conviction and greater portfolio diversification.

articles.summary: NRIs are permitted to open and maintain FCNR(B) accounts jointly with eligible resident relatives, subject to certain conditions.

articles.title: Gold loan jewellery stolen from bank? Consumer court ruling explains your compensation rights
articles.summary: A Karnataka consumer commission has ruled that if gold jewellery pledged for a loan is stolen from a bank, the lender must compensate for the gold value, making charges and stone value. Canara Bank was ordered to pay ₹88,362 with 9% interest, plus compensation.

articles.title: Doctor today, lawyer tomorrow: How do you save for your child’s education when they keep changing dreams?
articles.summary: In 2026, planning for a child's education fund is complex due to shifting career paths. Experts advise creating flexible investment structures.

articles.title: ITR filed successfully? Here are 8 income tax notices the department may send and what to do about them
articles.summary: Income Tax Returns (ITRs) are essential for lenders to assess borrowers' financial stability. Taxpayers should monitor communications from the Income Tax Department post-deadline for any discrepancies in filings. While minor errors can be resolved, serious issues may lead to scrutiny.

articles.title: RBI's special FCNR(B) deposit deadline nears: Should investors tap this opportunity before 31 August? Expert weighs in
articles.summary: The RBI has cut short the deadline for its special FCNR(B) deposit swap facility to 31 August from 30 September. With the window closing soon, NRIs need to weigh the potential benefits of higher foreign currency returns against the lock-in and liquidity considerations.

articles.title: Consistency beats quick fixes — 5 simple habits to build a bulletproof credit score
articles.summary: Credit score assessment relies heavily on four pillars: your track record of repaying debts, the proportion of available funds you currently use, the longevity of your active accounts, and the frequency of your recent loan applications.

articles.summary: Crude oil prices reach near one -month highs as the US plans extensive sanctions against Iran, aiming to isolate the country economically. Brent crude rose almost $3 to $92 a barrel while WTI jumped 3.3% to $86.72, amid rising tensions and Trump's warnings about economic penalties.

articles.title: US Treasury to double long-term bond buybacks; Bessent signals fiscal push as each could top $4 billion
articles.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Treasury bond buybacks could exceed $4 billion per issue, after the department announced plans to at least double purchases of longer-dated debt. He also signalled a stronger fiscal consolidation push to curb the deficit and reduce borrowing costs.

articles.title: Augmont Enterprises raises ₹246 crore from anchor investors ahead of IPO launch on Friday
articles.summary: Augmont Enterprises raised ₹246.29 crore from 14 anchor investors ahead of its IPO opening on Friday. The company allotted 31.25 lakh shares at ₹788 each. The IPO's price band is ₹750–788, aiming to raise ₹825 crore for working capital and general corporate purposes.

articles.title: Walmart shares plunge 10% to 9-month low after slowest US sales growth in six years
articles.summary: Walmart's shares dropped 10% to a nine-month low after missing quarterly sales estimates for the first time in over five years. Rising gasoline prices led to reduced consumer spending, and US comparable sales growth slowed to 2.6%. Despite challenges, Walmart raised its full-year sales guidance.
